test_case.test_name: Parameterized SSD destructive random-write512B QD1 sustained fio validation
test_case.purpose: Measure sustained512-byte random-write IOPS, bandwidth and latency on a signed-off empty bounded SSD range while protecting all OS, RAID, mounted and valuable data.
required_package: Offline empty target path plus serial/model/firmware and signed data-loss ownership
Explicit offset/size range, filesystem/raw state, OS/mount/RAID exclusion and total-write/endurance budget
Approved fio/libaio artifact and exact hashed job
Approval for10s ramp and43200s duration with SMART/thermal/error abort limits
Versioned IOPS/BW/latency thresholds, preconditioning and restore/reprovision plan
test_case.test_command: Enumerate disks, mounts, RAID/LVM/multipath and data ownership; require two-factor target confirmation by serial plus canonical path and verify the bounded range is empty/offline and non-OS; validate write budget and restore plan; run the pinned exact `rw=randwrite`, `bs=512b`, `iodepth=1`, `numjobs=1`, `ramp_time=10s`, `runtime=43200s`, `time_based` job once against only the approved offset/size; retain full structured/console output, bytes-written and telemetry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact destructive profile completes within the approved bounded range and write budget with zero I/O errors; device health stays inside limits; all approved IOPS/BW/latency thresholds pass; restoration/reprovision succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed target/range ownership, exact achieved profile/duration, complete evidence, bounded writes, healthy SMART/media state, all threshold comparisons and completed restore. Any missing binding, path drift, protected-disk match, shortened run, error or restore failure is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Fail closed unless serial and canonical path both match the signed empty target.
Reject OS disks, mounted filesystems, active RAID/LVM/multipath members and any valuable data.
Bound offset/size and total-write/endurance budget before starting.
Abort on path drift, SMART/media/AER error, thermal limit or write-budget breach; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Signed target ownership and serial/path/topology exclusion proof
Explicit offset/size and calculated write/endurance budget
fio artifact plus exact hashed job and full output
test_case.recovery: On any mismatch or health breach, stop immediately without retry, preserve logs, isolate the device and follow the approved restore/reformat/reprovision path; verify no protected device was touched and document resulting media health.
